name: HyperASHS-PMC
shortdesc: Hippocampal and MTL subfields segmentation in 3T T2-MRI
longdesc: Automatic segmentation of MTL subregions and hippocampal subfields in high-resolution T2-weighted 3 Tesla MRI scans, using the Penn Memory Center protocol (Yushkevich et al., 2014)

tags.name: T2-MRI
tags.hint: A high-resolution (e.g., 0.4x0.4x2.0mm^3) T2-weighted MRI scan with oblique coronal orientation parallel to hippocampal main axis. This scan must be the main image in the workspace.

tags.name: T1-MRI
tags.hint: Roughtly isotropic (e.g., 1x1x1mm^3) T1-weighted MRI scan of the whole brain.
